research_question: On a project-fresh frozen set, does V56's relation-bound event graph improve current-action commitment over the matched V54 architecture when both conditions reuse the exact same fresh V51 local-model judgment, without introducing a semantic or action regression?
project_effect: This tests one bounded cognition-to-action function: separating action mentions, descriptions, conditions, corrections, and executable requests before a future VRM action is authorized. It does not change memory, personality, right-brain wording, the active chat runtime, or physical actuation.
expected_effect: If typed event relations are the missing representation, V56 should preserve every V54-correct target, improve or match total commitment accuracy, produce no false action, and generalize across both exact external Japanese and frozen compositional relation families. If only final calls fail while commitments pass, the next experiment must repair only the compiler.
evidence_boundary: All 64 cases, 81 grounded targets, four conditions, and gates are frozen before any V56 holdout inference. Thirty-two cases preserve exact Tatoeba Japanese text and attribution; thirty-two are LLM-assisted controlled compositional cases reviewed before inference and are not official corpus items. Project freshness does not prove exclusion from the base model's pretraining data. A pass supports only this VRM action-perception slice, not broad human likeness or complete-system readiness.
model_usage_policy: Call the fixed local V51 model exactly once per grounded target. V54 and V56 must reuse that identical output as their fallback; neither architecture may make a second model call. This isolates relation representation from model intelligence, sampling, prompt, and compute.

causal_isolation.tested_variable: Replace V54 same-clause selective discourse state with V56 typed relation-bound event graph.
held_constant: local model digest and inference parameters
one shared fallback result per grounded target

target_mention_patterns.expression.neutral: (?:ニュートラル|いつも通り|いつもの|無表情|普通|標準|真顔|元)
target_mention_patterns.gaze.user: (?:会話相手|こちら|こっち|正面|カメラ|目線|私|俺|僕|目)
target_mention_patterns.motion.idle: (?:そのままの姿勢|動かない|動かず|じっと|アイドル|待機)

failure_routing.construction: If hashes, source provenance, candidate grounding, or overlap checks fail, stop before inference and freeze a corrected dataset.
failure_routing.resolved_state: If V56 resolves a target incorrectly or regresses from V54, reject fresh generalization and design a relation-level successor without tuning on this holdout.
failure_routing.fallback_model: If unresolved fallback targets are wrong, freeze that subset before comparing free local model sizes; do not assume larger or smaller is better.
failure_routing.compiler: If V56 commitment semantics pass but exact action calls fail, freeze V56 state semantics and preregister a compiler-only repair.
failure_routing.ambiguous_data: If independent review finds a gold item genuinely ambiguous, retire it transparently and do not relabel it to improve the score.

decision_rule.all_gates_pass: Authorize design of a no-actuation shadow experiment only after compiler review; do not change runtime or execute a VRM action.
decision_rule.state_and_matched_pass_end_to_end_fail: Freeze V56 state semantics and preregister a compiler-only repair.
decision_rule.semantic_regression: Reject V56 fresh generalization and design a relation-level revision.
decision_rule.fallback_error: Preregister a frozen fallback diagnostic before any model-size or prompt comparison.
decision_rule.other_failure: Reject advancement and use the prespecified failure attribution to select the next one-variable experiment.
